scope: Every repository test file with basename motocross*.test.ts or offroad*.test.ts

aggregate.countingRule: Only this completed final run contributes counts. Interrupted, historical full and overlapping targeted runs are excluded.

sourceIdentity.algorithm: SHA-256 of lexically sorted POSIX path + NUL + bytes + NUL; all src files plus package-lock.json, index.html and vite.config.ts

limitations: Unit acceptance does not substitute for native-browser or player testing.
This assignment made no production, test, model, character-asset, authored-environment, build-output or git-state edits.
